name: order-edit-window
title: Order edit window
description: Tell shoppers a fresh order can still be changed: the time left in words, actions to edit the address or items or cancel, and a calm swap when time is up.
docs: editableUntil is the moment the order stops being editable, with its offset ("2026-10-20T10:24:00Z"). The time is written in whole minutes, rounded down, and updates once a minute; only the 10 minute and 1 minute marks and the end are announced, politely, and never for where the time already stands when the page loads. At zero both sentences are laid in one cell, so the strip does not change size, the actions go aria-disabled (still focusable, so a keyboard user is not dropped), and onExpire is called once; never trust the browser for this, lock the order on your server as well. onAction receives address, items or cancel; cancel is only reported after the shopper confirms in the dialog, whose focus starts on Keep order. windowMinutes (optional) is the length of the whole window and adds a thin bar for how much is left. Pass now in tests and previews; without it the first render says "You can still change this order" and the time appears once the browser's clock is read. remaining.ts holds the arithmetic and runs on the server too.
